answer: Each identity registers one free-running crystal and proves custody by posting a whisper-quiet phase-noise sample each epoch that matches its aging curve within 5 ppb. A farm of 80 aliases needs 80 distinct crystals (~$12 each) in copper-shielded fixtures; cloning a curve fails the Allan-deviation check at settlement and shared oscillators collapse to one seat. Failure mode: temperature spoofing is caught by a random thermal step honest curves follow and canned traces miss.
